core_meaning.primary_meaning: Selahattin is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Righteousness of the faith”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Selahattin corresponds to the Arabic form صَلَاحُ الدِّين (Arabic صَلَاح (ṣalāḥ) + الدِّين (al-dīn)). Its core sense is selahattin; righteousness of the faith (turkish form). Selahattin is the Turkish form of Arabic صَلَاحُ الدِّين (Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn), meaning 'righteousness of the faith'. It was borne by Saladin.
